body.statement: A joint law generated by a pairwise-identifiable CPCM has a unique labeled generating DAG.

source.verbatim_statement: Let \(F_X\) be generated by the pairwise identifiable CPCM with DAG \(\mathcal G\). Then, \(\mathcal G\) is identifiable from the joint distribution.

attestation.note: Transcribed from Lemma 11 in the official JMLR PDF.
